claim: completions capability declared but tool-argument completion handlers not wired to completion/complete protocol requests
actual: FULLY IMPLEMENTED at src/server/control-plane-registration.ts:93-189. Stale comment at features-2025-11-25.ts:381-383 caused this. Comment now fixed.
lesson: Search for implementation before trusting a comment that says 'not yet implemented'

claim: execute-stdio-tool-call.js:79 calls buildToolResponse without toolName/outputSchema
actual: Line 79 is an interface field declaration. buildToolResponse calls are at lines 187, 224, 261, 264
lesson: Never report a specific line number without Read(file, offset=N-2, limit=8) to verify content

claim: INTERNAL_ERROR hardcoded at execute-stdio-tool-call.js:112
actual: Line 112 is an interface field. INTERNAL_ERROR fallback is at lines 264-273
lesson: Same as above — synthesized line number from pattern reasoning, not file read

claim: DUMMY_WEBHOOK_SECRET allows any request through verification
actual: REFUTED. The !secret || !isValid compound check at webhook-verification.ts:281-289 always rejects when no real secret is configured. !secret is always true when null.
lesson: Read the FULL function including all conditional branches, not just the line where a suspicious constant is used

claim: Circuit breaker threshold=5/timeout=30s blocks ALL Sheets calls for 30s on rate-limited bursts
actual: REFUTED. QuotaCircuitBreaker at circuit-breaker.ts:61-139 has readOnlyMode fallback (no hard-block). Quota threshold is actually 3/60s to match Google's recommended cool-down.
lesson: Trace the complete inheritance chain and registered callbacks before characterizing behavior

claim: 53 tautological assertions remain after ISSUE-237
actual: 70 instances. grep -rn pattern | wc -l gives 70, not 53
lesson: ALWAYS run grep | wc -l for any count claim. Never estimate a specific number.

claim: 10 error codes suppressed by MCP_NON_FATAL_TOOL_ERRORS
actual: 13 codes. Read tool-response.ts:53-67 directly — Set has 13 entries
lesson: Count Set/Array entries by reading the actual declaration, not by reasoning about scope

claim: ~1GB peak memory for 500MB streaming export due to serialization pass
actual: Peak is ~500MB (guard threshold). bytesProcessed counter is per-chunk. There is no second-pass full-allData serialization.
lesson: Read the FULL function including the bytesProcessed tracking logic before characterizing memory behavior

claim: Both STDIO and HTTP transports use the same 26-step middleware chain via createToolCallHandler
actual: WRONG. STDIO uses packages/mcp-stdio path through dispatchServerToolCall (handler-dispatch.ts:43). createToolCallHandler at tool-handlers.ts:890 is HTTP-only via http-server/runtime-factory.ts.
lesson: When a ground-truth agent makes this exact mistake AGAIN: pattern-matched from reading tool-handlers.ts without verifying which transports call it. Always trace from the ENTRYPOINT, not from the handler implementation.

claim: Previous audits covered all security issues
actual: ReDoS in quality.ts:182 via new RegExp(rule.pattern) with no length cap — DoS attack via MCP interface. Also batch-custom-explain.ts:55-56 unescaped column headers in RegExp.
lesson: ReDoS requires explicitly checking every new RegExp() call with user-controlled input — prior audits did not grep for this pattern

claim: All production dependencies are license-compatible
actual: hyperformula@3.2.0 is GPL-3.0-only in PRODUCTION dependencies (not devDependencies). Commercial distribution without license violates GPL-3.0 copyleft.
lesson: Always run license-checker on production dependencies before launch — npm audit does not check licenses

claim: Redis session store works correctly
actual: RedisSessionStore at src/storage/session-store.ts:113 never calls client.connect(). First use throws ClientClosedError. node-redis v4 requires explicit connect().
lesson: node-redis v4 changed connect() to be explicit — not backward compatible with v3 auto-connect behavior

claim: Caches are properly tenant-isolated
actual: ETag cache key format is {spreadsheetId}:{endpoint}:{range} with NO user ID. In multi-tenant HTTP mode User B receives User A's cached spreadsheet data.
lesson: Cache key design must include tenant/user scoping for any data-bearing cache — spreadsheetId alone is not unique per user

claim: OTel observability works when OTEL_ENABLED=true
actual: otel-setup.ts:26 reads ENABLE_OTEL but env.ts:91 defines OTEL_ENABLED. Setting OTEL_ENABLED=true passes validation but OTel silently never starts.
lesson: Always grep all uses of an env var name before assuming the Zod schema and the consuming code agree on the name

claim: Sampling consent is user-controlled
actual: SAMPLING_CONSENT_REQUIRED defaults to false — spreadsheet cell data sent to LLMs without consent by default. This is a GDPR Arts. 13,22,28 violation for EU users.
lesson: Privacy-sensitive defaults must be opt-in (true) not opt-out (false) for GDPR compliance

claim: Redis bug at session-store.ts:113 does NOT exist. ensureConnected() at lines 120-124 correctly calls client.connect() before every operation. node-redis v5 (not v4) is installed.
verified_output: 120: private async ensureConnected()  121: if (!this.client.isOpen)  122: await this.client.connect();
lesson: Check the FULL class for lazy-connect patterns before claiming connect() is missing. ensureConnected() guard is correct node-redis v4/v5 pattern.

claim: No GPL-3.0 production dependency found. All production deps are MIT/Apache-2.0/ISC/BSD. The hyperformula GPL claim was not verified against actual license-checker output.
verified_output: 'license': 'MIT' — project is MIT. No GPL strings in package.json production deps.
lesson: Always run npx license-checker --production before claiming a GPL dependency. Pattern-matching dep names is not sufficient.

claim: OTel ENABLE_OTEL vs OTEL_ENABLED mismatch was ALREADY FIXED before the meta-analysis audit. Comment at otel-setup.ts:26-31 explicitly documents the past bug and confirms it is resolved.
verified_output: otel-setup.ts:29: process.env['OTEL_ENABLED'] — correct, matches Zod schema
lesson: Read the full function including comments before flagging env var mismatches. A comment saying 'previously broken, now fixed' means it IS fixed.

claim: batch-custom-explain.ts:55 ReDoS is MITIGATED. escapeRegExp() at line 53 correctly escapes all regex metacharacters from column headers before use in RegExp constructor. Comment on lines 51-52 explicitly documents the threat model.
lesson: Read the lines BEFORE a new RegExp() call to check for sanitization. A ReDoS claim requires showing that user input reaches RegExp without escaping.

claim: ReDoS vulnerability in quality.ts:179-188 (new RegExp without length cap)
refutation: createSafeRegex() in src/utils/safe-regex-factory.ts wraps all pattern compilation with nested-quantifier detection + 500-char user limit; schema adds 200-char max at src/schemas/quality.ts:112

claim: ETag cache keys missing userId (cross-tenant data leak, CVSS 9.1) at read-write.ts:189
refutation: userId IS included in cache key at src/handlers/data-actions/read-write.ts:193 via ha.context.sessionContext?.getUserId(); key format: {userId}:{spreadsheetId}:endpoint:range:params
